title: CME: how market liquidity is measured
supports: Microstructure liquidity uses spread, order-book depth and cost to trade. Weekly OHLC does not observe these.

title: CME: Nasdaq futures history
supports: E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures launched in 1999; a cash-index history is not a futures history.

title: Nasdaq: 40 years of the Nasdaq-100
supports: Nasdaq-100 launch date 31 January 1985. Retrieved Yahoo daily record begins 1 October 1985.

title: S&P Dow Jones Indices: S&P 500
supports: Modern 500-stock index launched 4 March 1957. Earlier vendor history is predecessor/back-history, not a live S&P 500.

title: Yahoo Help: adjusted closing prices
supports: Adjusted close accounts for splits and distributions; adjusted OHLC sensitivity here uses one common daily factor for all four fields.

title: Stora Enso: corporate history
supports: Ownership document for the Falun copper mine dates to 1288; modern corporate history includes mergers. This is not a 1288 weekly share-price series.

title: MPS: group history
supports: Operating origins in 1472 and Milan share listing on 25 June 1999.

title: Orell Füssli: history
supports: Printing roots in 1519; corporate timeline includes the 1897 exchange listing. Full page retrieval was blocked; indexed official content and corroborating historical sources were used.

title: Matsui Construction: history
supports: Origins in 1586; incorporated in 1939; Tokyo Second Section listing in 1961, First Section in 1966.

title: Sumitomo Metal Mining: history
supports: Copper-smelting roots in 1590; present issuer is successor to the historical business.

title: CIBC Mellon: parent-company history
supports: Bank of New York was the first company listed on the NYSE in 1792. Present BNY corporate identity reflects later mergers.

title: BNY: 2026 ticker change announcement
supports: Issuer announcement changing ticker BK to BNY; predecessor founded in 1784 and first traded in 1792.

title: Con Edison: bicentennial
supports: Founded in 1823; issuer describes its NYSE listing as the exchange's longest continuous listing.

title: JPX: Yomeishu delisting decision
supports: Yomeishu delisted 18 June 2026, so is excluded from the still-trading screen.

title: MPS: 2017 annual report
supports: Shares readmitted to trading on 25 October 2017; carried zero-volume vendor prices during suspension are excluded.

title: Yale: historical NYSE research data
supports: Longer archival price records exist, but the described collection includes periodic prices/interpolation and does not establish daily observed OHLC for this study.
